product_overview: Student Flow PM is an AI-powered academic project management platform designed specifically for students, combining enterprise-grade tools with simplicity to eliminate friction, provide context-aware management, and deliver data-driven insights tailored for academic workflows.
core_goals: Eliminate friction with AI-assisted project setup and task generation
Provide context-aware management inspired by NotebookLM intelligence
Deliver automated analytics and visual progress tracking
Design an intuitive UX optimized for students, not corporate project managers
key_features: Authentication & User Management including registration, login, password recovery, and profile setup
Multi-step Project Management with AI-suggested timelines, task generation, and progress tracking
Task Management with CRUD operations, nested subtasks, priorities, statuses, and dependencies
AI-Powered Features such as smart task generation, document analysis, and progress insights
Calendar & Timeline views with color coding, multi-project support, and quick task additions
Resource Management for files and links with tagging, search, and version tracking
Collaboration including project messaging, real-time chat, notifications, and activity feeds
Data Insights & Analytics dashboards with charts, velocity tracking, and productivity analysis
Shared Project Space for collaborative group work with team overview and shared resources
user_flow_summary: Primary Flow: User creates new project via multi-step wizard with AI task and milestone suggestions, then navigates to project page to manage tasks and view AI insights
Secondary Flow: User uploads academic documents for AI-powered extraction of key requirements and automatic task generation, then reviews and accepts tasks
Tertiary Flow: User manages tasks through calendar view by viewing, adding, rescheduling, or editing tasks across multiple projects
validation_criteria: User can register, login, reset password, and setup profile without errors
Projects can be created, edited, deleted, and archived with AI-generated task suggestions confirmed by users
Tasks support full CRUD operations including nested subtasks and status/priority updates
AI features accurately analyze documents and provide context-aware suggestions accepted by >40% users
Calendar displays all project deadlines with color coding and supports quick task addition and rescheduling
Resource uploads linkable to tasks with proper organization and search functionality
Real-time messaging and notifications function with proper user settings management
Data insights dashboards update correctly and reflect accurate project and productivity metrics
Performance meets requirements: dashboard loads <2s, API calls respond <500ms, uptime >99.5%
